meta.title: Geopets · Animated pixel-art pets in SVG and GIF
meta.description: 145 free animated pixel-art pets shaped like a square, triangle, circle, diamond and hexagon. Moods, HTTP status codes and a pet maker. Download as SVG or GIF, CC BY 4.0.
meta.ogAlt: Five pixel-art Geopets: Cubo, Tri, Bola, Rombi and Hexa

hero.lead: Animated pixel-art pets shaped like a square, triangle, circle, diamond and hexagon. Pure SVG with CSS animation, zero dependencies. Download them, or draw your own on a 13×9 pixel grid.
